statement.zh: 通论（Algaze、Liverani、Pollock）将第四千纪乌鲁克阶段表述为讨论南部早期城市化、复杂行政与对外联系的关键节点。
statement.en: Handbooks (Algaze, Liverani, Pollock) frame the 4th-millennium Uruk period as a key horizon for southern urbanization, administration, and external linkage.
